newsitem.title: UK: WH Smith completes retail sale/leaseback.
newsitem.headline: WH Smith completes retail sale/leaseback.

text.p: British retail WH Smith Group Plc said on Thursday that it had successfully completed the sale and leaeback of 14 WH Smith retail properties for a consideration of 55 million stg.
"The transaction, which is marginally earnings enhancing, will be used to reduce group debt and provide financing for investment," the group said in a statement.
The properties are to be leased back for a total initial annual rent of some 3.0 million stg under 15-year leases with five-year rent reviews.
"This move will further strengthen our balance sheet and is another step towards focusing our resources on core trading activities," chief executive Bill Cockburn said.
